description: Validate 1 to 50 games (team names or event_ids plus canonical market, outcome, and optional line/odds) on a target bookmaker and create a 10-minute plan_id for mbc_book_code. Returns per-game status ('resolved', 'ambiguous', 'not_found', 'market_missing', 'odds_changed', 'not_bookable'). Costs 0 action credits.

accept_odds_change.description: Accept moved odds beyond 1% tolerance (default false).

market.description: Canonical market (e.g. '1X2', 'Over/Under', 'Both Teams To Score', 'Double Chance').

strict.description: Require all games to resolve (default true).

name: mbc_resolve_picks
title: Resolve Games Into a 10-Minute Booking Plan
